reason: A DSH Web plugin that monitors a DeepSeek account balance through a server proxy, displays balance details in a movable floating widget, refreshes periodically, and provides low-balance alerts and a top-up link.

summaries.zh: 通过服务端代理获取并定时刷新 DeepSeek 账户余额，在可拖动的悬浮组件中显示余额、低余额提醒和充值入口。
summaries.en: Monitors and periodically refreshes a DeepSeek account balance through a server proxy, displaying it in a movable widget with low-balance alerts and a top-up link.

capabilities: reads a configured DeepSeek API credential through the server credential system
sends authenticated requests to the DeepSeek balance API
displays and periodically refreshes account balance information
stores the chosen widget position in localStorage
links users to the DeepSeek top-up page
